contentBlocks.text: How to Check Your SRD R370 Grant Status

Checking your SRD R370 grant status is essential every month. Because the SRD grant is re-evaluated monthly, your status can change from one month to the next. There are four ways to check your status — use whichever is most convenient for you.
The online portal is the most reliable method. It shows your detailed status, pay dates, and any outstanding actions.

steps.title: Visit srd.sassa.gov.za
steps.description: Open the website on your phone, tablet, or computer. The site works on all devices and networks.

steps.title: Enter your ID number
steps.description: Type your 13-digit South African ID number in the field provided.

steps.title: Enter your phone number
steps.description: Enter the mobile phone number you used when you applied for the grant.

steps.title: Request and enter OTP
steps.description: Click 'Send OTP'. You will receive a one-time PIN via SMS. Enter it on the website.

steps.title: View your status dashboard
steps.description: Your dashboard shows your current status (Pending, Approved, Declined, etc.), payment dates, and a history of previous months.

contentBlocks.text: The SASSA WhatsApp service is free on most networks and works on any smartphone with WhatsApp installed.

steps.title: Follow the menu prompts
steps.description: The automated system will guide you through options. Select 'Check Status' and enter your ID number when prompted.

steps.title: Receive your status
steps.description: The system will reply with your current grant status and any available payment information.

contentBlocks.text: USSD works on any phone, including basic feature phones. Standard network rates apply.

items: Follow the on-screen menu to check your grant status
You will need your ID number ready
The result displays on your phone screen within seconds

contentBlocks.text: If you do not have access to a phone or the internet, visit your nearest SASSA local office. Bring your ID document. A SASSA officer can look up your status and provide a printed confirmation if needed.

faqs.question: How often should I check my SRD status?
faqs.answer: Check at the beginning of each month to see your status for that month's payment cycle.

faqs.question: Why does my status not show on the portal?
faqs.answer: The portal may be experiencing high traffic. Try again later or use the WhatsApp or USSD method instead.

faqs.question: Can someone else check my status for me?
faqs.answer: No. The system requires your ID number and the phone number registered to your application. OTP verification ensures only you can access your status.

faqs.question: My status says 'No Application Found'. What do I do?
faqs.answer: This means your ID is not registered in the SRD system. You may need to submit a new application, or there may be a system error. Try again later or contact SASSA.

faqs.question: Can I check my status without a phone?
faqs.answer: Yes. Visit your nearest SASSA office with your ID. A SASSA officer can look up your status and provide a printout.
